items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: my wife, who was the vocalist in the band, Evelyn, she sang a tune called "I Nearly Lost My Mind" on one of the records

ctx.x: House," "The Open House Show." That was my tune called "Open House." Then there was another tune that Irving Ashby, (PHONETIC) the guitar player, wrote called "Stratosphere." No, it was not "Stratosphere," "Altitude," and some other things like that.

On the tune, on that particular session, the tune -- my wife, who was the vocalist in the band, Evelyn, she sang a tune called "I Nearly Lost My Mind" on one of the records, which was very, very badly recorded, wrong tempo, wrong key, wrong everything. It wasn't a good recording at all and didn't do her justice at all.
Was she listed as Evelyn Royal?
